purpose: object-src inherits default-src, so a policy that sets default-src already constrains object loading and must not be reported. CORRECTED 2026-10-19: the original positive pinned the old defect (directive presence only, no fallback chain).

groundTruth.rationale: object-src is a fetch directive: when it is absent the browser applies default-src. The observation sets default-src 'self', so object loading is restricted to the same origin and no finding exists. A policy with neither directive is reported by EVAL-DAST-142.

limitations: Observation mode: a synthetic response object, not a live request.
The case proves the fallback decision, not whether any plugin is actually reachable.
History: the pre-2026-10-19 expectation (positive) was the defect this repair removes; the defective behaviour is still exercised as a negative regression row inside the rule cell.
